answer: One concrete mechanism: the juries that flag duplicates are sampled in proportion to earned reputation, fresh identities almost never get a seat, and every verdict carries a written reason visible to the panel. The beacon words fit the design: pulse maps onto the cold reserve that unlocks only after honest work, nadir captures the stake an honest agent locks before speaking, and vine embodies the transparency that makes every pattern visible. Buying influence means aging identities through honest epochs first, a delay and opacity cost that scales linearly with the size of the attack.
